status: Frozen design only; no build or matching authorized by this file
objective: Compare existing pad64 with full-bank automatic minimum total-size padding, keeping source origin/grid phase, bank, core and thresholds fixed; report both gains and regressions
bank_policy: Reuse exact serialized full 3456-ID bank; no retraining, dropping poses, scale changes, threshold changes or feature-count gating
baseline_policy: Exact original left/top64 with right/bottom64+16-alignment remainder; archived baseline quality unchanged; eight fresh pilot fallback/fused outputs must match their old same-padding raw cache
auto_policy: Preserve baseline left/top64 and at least baseline total size; A=lcm(2^l*T_l); scan every class/template/level; required refined dimension=2^l*(max declared extent+16*T_l); coarse=2^c*max(declared extent,actual max feature coordinate+1); align maximum up to A; extra area on right/bottom only
geometry_validation: Check every actual loaded template, feature coordinates and final per-level divisibility; fail on malformed negative/inconsistent extents or declared extent<actual maximum, never rewrite features; report all binding poses and residual margins. This is geometric feasibility only, not a physical SIMD-read safety proof.
coordinate_policy: Unchanged padded match_x/match_y; use actual left/top in frozen silhouette-origin bbox transform; compare original-image output boxes; no subtracting right/bottom and no clipping
raw_policy: No cache reuse across padding arms. Preserve every raw candidate and manifest for each fresh call; compare fallback/fused all original fields and float32 bits within each arm; A/B outputs may legitimately differ.

pilot.purpose: Correctness/byte equivalence to old baseline, actual bank preflight, coordinate checks and resource feasibility; not tuning or a stable speed claim

full_quality.baseline: Use already frozen corresponding actual85 baseline candidate archives only after full input/core/bank/config/frame hashes and paired-path equality revalidation
full_quality.run_condition: Pilot correctness/resource checks pass even if pilot accuracy is unchanged or worse; do not select on pilot gain

timing.ordering: Per frame and round cycle the four arm/path combinations by round modulo4; fixed frame order from frame_schedule; no concurrent heavy workload; OMP4 dynamicFALSE activelevels1 passive wait; report samples and medians/p95/paired ratios
timing.external_call_phase: Input already decoded grayscale; include new copyMakeBorder, detector.match, canonical score filter/NMS and original-coordinate conversion; exclude imread/training/GT/CSV/drawing; report decode and bank load separately
timing.correctness: Every timed variant output must equal its own canonical arm/path frozen-quality candidate list; never require baseline==auto

resource_budget.overflow: Checked uint64 arithmetic for shifts, LCM, alignment, pixel/stride products and resource estimates
resource_budget.on_budget_exceeded: Abort and preserve incomplete failure evidence with required dimensions/binding template; never truncate, treat missing outputs as negatives, change bank/parameters, or resume with a silent new budget

quality_reporting: allGT and eligible TP/FP/FN precision recall F1 mean TP IoU
per-scene and per-visibility results; target-negative-frame FP and frames with FP
baseline GT ID retention/loss/new coverage and exact original TP detection retention; do not equate total TP difference with old-TP loss
complete raw/post85/NMS candidate counts, bank geometry before/after, original/padded-domain candidate extents
all failures and unavailable/incomplete frames; no industrial accuracy extrapolation
required_synthetic_checks: one below/equal/above each refined/coarse bound, width and height independently
odd dimensions and nontrivial T arrays/LCM; arithmetic/resource overflows reject
full-bank max extents from different template IDs and feature max==declared extent
same left/top with changed right/bottom preserves coordinate transform exactly
negative/malformed loaded features explicit rejection, never normalization
strict IoU=.3 NMS boundary and one-to-one/eligible-ignore rules unchanged
promotion: No production-default change. Geometry restoration, positive retention, FP and speed each require independent review. Heldout remains unopened throughout this design and development comparison.
artifact_scope: Static protocol/planning only; no public frozen source changes, compilation, training, decoding or matching

design_correction.reason: Static actual-feature-inclusive validation found four coarse coordinate==dimension cases omitted by historical declared-extent fit flags; preserve historical630 and separately report new634; no image experiment or policy tuning occurred.
